server._spawnProtectionComment: Same as spawn-protection in the server's server.properties (0 = off). Non-op players can't break or place blocks this close to the world spawn, so the bots avoid digging there.

ai._providerComment: auto = use Claude if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is in .env, otherwise OpenAI if OPENAI_API_KEY is. Or set "anthropic" / "openai".

_imposterComment: 2 secret imposters, chosen once at least minVillagers are alive. They may kill when a kill window is open (every killEveryDays Minecraft days, the first firstKillAfterDays after they were chosen; up to killsPerWindow kills), and only with nobody within witnessRadius blocks. Villagers within seeRadius of a death see it.
_societyComment: Elections start when there is no leader or the term (in Minecraft days) is over; they close when all voted or after electionMinutes real minutes.

pricing._comment: US dollars per million tokens. cacheWrite is the 5-minute cache write (1.25x input). Haiku 5.5 prices are for prompts up to 100K tokens. OpenAI prices from developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Nov 2026).

village._comment: centre null = use the world spawn point. Set {"x":..,"y":..,"z":..} to pick a spot.

chat._villagerWakesComment: How often another villager's chat may wake a bot (each wake = one AI call). Players' chat always wakes it.
